name: Salary Negotiation
description: You have received a job offer from a mid-sized tech company and are negotiating your compensation package before deciding whether to accept.
backstory: You're a software engineer with 3 years of experience. You've done your research — the market rate for this role is $90k–$95k. You currently earn $83k and are hoping to get a meaningful raise.

name: Vendor Contract
description: You're in a meeting with a software vendor's sales rep. They want to lock you into a 2-year contract. You're here to push back on price and terms.

name: Apartment Rent Negotiation
description: You have found two apartments you like and are negotiating with the landlord of your preferred option to get the best possible deal.
backstory: You've been a reliable tenant for 2 years, currently paying $2,000/month. Your landlord wants to raise it to $2,400 — a $400 jump. You've done your research — comparable units in the area go for $2,100–$2,200. You'd prefer to stay but are willing to look elsewhere if the increase is unreasonable.
